Changes: Fixed: the sidebar could still be Alt+Tab'd to. In 4.2.0 that fix was tied to the "Desktop Widget Mode" checkbox, which was off in some existing settings. The sidebar is now always kept out of Alt+Tab / the task switcher and shown on every virtual desktop, and the redundant checkbox has been removed from Settings > Advanced.

Fixed: SideMon still appeared in Alt+Tab / the task switcher despite "Toolbar Mode" being on by default. The hide-from-switcher style was applied too late (after the window was first shown), so Windows ignored it. It's now set before the first show, and toggling the setting takes effect immediately. The setting is renamed "Desktop Widget Mode": SideMon behaves like a desktop gadget, off the taskbar and out of Alt+Tab, unless you turn it off.

Turning off "Always On Top" now makes the sidebar a true desktop-level widget, pinned behind ordinary windows and lifted into view only while the desktop is shown (Win+D). Default (Always On Top) is unchanged.
Fixed: the FPS overlay could be Alt+Tab'd to; it's now a tool window like the sidebar.

Fixed: enabling/disabling individual metrics in the Monitors tab applied immediately and couldn't be undone with Cancel; the dialog now edits a private copy, so only Save/Apply commits metric changes.
New Motherboard monitor: chipset/VRM temperature, case fan, and voltage sensors.
New Battery monitor: charge level, time remaining, charge/discharge rate, and voltage.

New FPS overlay (Settings > Overlay tab): a small, minimalist, click-through counter in any screen corner, adjustable opacity, matching the sidebar's theme. Reads live stats from RivaTuner Statistics Server (RTSS) if installed and running; shows "No RTSS" otherwise.

Fixed: the installer could freeze on "Preparing to Install" while an older version was still running, caused by Inno Setup's automatic Restart Manager check; the installer already force-closes the app itself, so the redundant check is now disabled.
New Vertical Align option (Top/Middle/Bottom) for the sidebar's content.

Content that overflows the screen height now shrinks automatically to fit instead of scrolling or clipping, by writing the needed scale into UI Scale (Advanced tab), so everything stays visible no matter how many drives you show or how large your font/UI scale is.
UI Scale is now hard-capped once your monitors need more room than the screen, with a note in Advanced explaining why.
Fixed: auto-fit only worked reliably on first launch; toggling monitors afterward could leave items overflowing uncorrected. Fixed: the shown UI Scale value could have too many decimal places.

Fixed: UI Scale could get stuck too small even after removing enough monitors to fit again, because of a pre-existing bug where changing UI Scale corrupts the window's tracked height. Auto-fit now measures against the real screen instead.
Run at Startup now confirms whether it actually succeeded, instead of failing silently like it did (undetected) for a long time before 4.1.0.
Fixed: in Desktop Blur mode, Show after Hide brought the sidebar in front of other windows instead of staying behind them; the bottom-of-stack policy is now reapplied every time the sidebar is shown.
New: General settings now shows PawnIO driver status, with a manual install button and progress indicator when it's missing.

Fixed: the PawnIO driver install prompt could fail to ever appear on startup, because it waited for a fully-idle dispatcher queue that continuous sensor-polling UI updates could keep busy indefinitely. It's now scheduled with a short fixed delay instead.
Failures in the PawnIO prompt flow are now written to error.log instead of silently disappearing.
Fixed: opening Settings could crash if a removable/USB drive was monitored and became briefly unavailable.
Fixed: the guided PawnIO driver install could fail with a file-in-use error on a retry.
New card panel style: each monitor group is shown as a rounded dashboard card, similar to gaming performance overlays. On by default; switch back under Customize.
Accent color setting for card icons and load bars (default cyan).
Slim accent load bars under every percentage metric in card mode.
Background is now one of three styles: Solid Color, Windows Accent Color, or Desktop Blur (Glass).
Desktop Blur shows your actual wallpaper (blurred), never your open windows, and aligns pixel-perfectly with the desktop.
New Blur Width slider: the glass can extend beyond the sidebar and fade into the desktop.
In Desktop Blur mode the sidebar behaves like part of the desktop: windows cover it, and Win+D keeps it visible.
Settings window redesigned: wider two-column layout with grouped sections; always fits your screen.
Fixed: GPU VRAM bar showed full when displaying VRAM in GB.
Fixed: background could vanish when applying settings live.

Improved first run on a clean machine: the sensor driver installs in the background with a progress indicator instead of appearing to freeze, and a fresh install no longer crashes if hardware access briefly fails.
Fixed: Run at Startup silently failed to create its scheduled task due to an invalid command, meaning the app never actually started with Windows.
Fixed: the guided PawnIO driver install used the wrong command-line flag and always failed with "Unknown argument: /S".
After the driver installs, SideMon now asks whether to reload now or later instead of reloading silently.
